meta.cv: 5 x StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True), random_state = 42 + repeat, group = cv_group (patient_id, merged across near-duplicate images)
meta.feature_selection: label-free Spearman redundancy pruning fit inside each training fold (kept features per fold in folds[].features)
meta.headline: fold_mean: mean over all 25 folds with a 95% Nadeau-Bengio corrected t-interval
meta.pooled: first repeat (seed 42) pooled out-of-fold metrics, confusion matrix and curves; 95% percentile bootstrap over patients

primary.note: PRIMARY: quality-clean images (no blur / upscaled / high-glare flags), colour candidates pruned in-fold.

secondary_all.note: Secondary analysis: all kept images, quality-flagged ones included.

shortcut_ablation.note: NOT THE REAL MODEL. Primary images plus glare_frac and tissue_px (image-acquisition shortcuts) to show how much they inflate scores.
